subject: Heads of Research Dinner | CVPR'25 | 14 June
text:
Hi Paul,

I saw you're presenting your poster at CVPR this year, so I wanted to reach
out with an invite from our Head of ML Frederik Hvilshøj. He's hosting
a dinner and fireside chat for Heads of Research/ Applied Science attending
the conference on Saturday (6/14) & would love to welcome you!

We'll kick off at 6:30pm with a fireside chat with Luc Vincent (Chief R&D
Officer at Nexar, formerly VP of AI at Meta) as he reflects on his career
and the toughest challenges still facing teams scaling computer vision
models today.

The discussion will continue over dinner, joined by Heads of AI from
Captions, Adobe, Synthesia, etc.

In case Encord is new to you... we help over 200 AI teams improve data
quality for model development, with the goals of reducing time spent on
training dataset preparation & accelerate model iterations.

Happy to share details if you're in Nashville then?

Best,
Winnie
